parcel-console.README.md:
# Parcel console
Owned synthetic actions; gateway authority is unspecified.
parcel-console.ui/AAQueue.vue:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { queueParcel } from "./queue";
const props = defineProps<{ parcel: string; tenant: string }>();
const enqueue = () => queueParcel(props.parcel, props.tenant);
</script>
<template><button @click="enqueue">Queue parcel</button></template>
